hero.label: Made for Airgoods
hero.headline: I want to help Airgoods own the specialty food shelf.
hero.subheadline: Airgoods is doing something genuinely rare: giving emerging brands like Fishwife and Ghia a real path into independent grocers without the chaos of traditional wholesale. I want to be the person building the retailer side of that engine from the ground up, and I have the outbound and relationship skills to do it.

whyCompany.title: Specialty food retail is fragmented and Airgoods is the fix
whyCompany.body: Independent grocers and specialty food stores are notoriously hard to reach at scale, which is exactly why a marketplace like Airgoods creates so much leverage for both sides. The brands you work with, Fishwife, Ghia, David Protein, are the ones consumers are already seeking out. Connecting them to the right retail shelf at the right moment is a real unlock.

whyCompany.title: Building the first retailer growth function is a rare opportunity
whyCompany.body: You are not backfilling a role, you are creating the playbook. For a YC S23 company at this stage, whoever owns retailer acquisition and onboarding now will shape how Airgoods scales for years. That kind of early ownership is exactly what I am looking for at the start of my career.

whyCompany.title: My BDR reps translate directly to retailer outreach and GMV growth
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and on LinkedIn that contributed to acquiring 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch. At NextAfter I learned how to frame value propositions for niche B2B audiences where trust and specificity matter. Convincing an independent grocer to take a chance on a new brand is exactly that kind of sale.

quote: I grew up playing soccer at two universities and learned that the players who win are the ones who do the unglamorous work before the ball even arrives. I want to be the person at Airgoods who earns retailer trust one conversation at a time and builds the foundation that makes the GMV numbers possible.
